# Notes

ZeroSDK's working record: what is planned and what audits found. A note is deleted once it is done, and what lasts from it moves to [docs](../docs/README.md). This folder does not ship to a fork.

- [Audits](audits/README.md) - reports of what an audit found.
- [Plans](plans/README.md) - the backlog, one file per item.
